book.name: Matai
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Matai byex o

content: Qayeeng pakeing wei mata ngandoung wei iingama yo
Yesu luk is xel lu nge no eivek qayeeng pakeing, me neil embei,
“Tete lalei wei tyoung gheyapu eno nambei king ti wei menyex wou mata ngandoung wei iingama yo en neu moux.
Moxo wong e xe xel xukxe la wou eti yeiw wei wong qayeeng la me neil wou xel bei xel nam en mata ngandoung wei iingama yo, ekom xel pesek bei se nam.

“Woyom moxo wong xel xukxe valu no la me neil, ‘Neil wou xel wei a wong qayeeng la wou xel bei a menyex wou a xe yaeing woy, “Wei, a xe manghaxo me leliy wei ling tata yo eno xel leis me ghuw, me lul sapa a menyex wou woy. Xam lam en mata ngandoung wei iingama ne.” ’
“Ekom xel se di li nenyend wou qayeeng qe xel la. Ti la e xe xuk, de nge la emaxow xe xuk malew.
De xel ba zeimaxoun e xe xel xukxe me wo nol wou xel de leis xel mey.
King moxo lalei wo vanei mouyo. Om wong e xe xel vevekyeiw la me semaleeng xel tiwei leis xel xukxe mey yo me nyuw beyeeng ngandoung wei xel on is.
“Woyom neil wou e xe xel xukxe bei, ‘A menyex wou mata ngandoung wei iingama eno woy, ekom xel wei a wong qayeeng la bei xel nam eno xel on se nimza teyei bei nam.
Om xam ghe na sakwaingta dalus me eti yeiw wei xam ghe gweiwou eno xam a qou me ghe nam eivek mata ngandoung wei iingama ne.’
Om xel xukxe la eivek sakwaingta dalus nei me qekuwou xomaxoneing dalus wei xel yeiwou yo, xel nimza me nilul is, om xomek lalei wei mata ngandoung wei iingama yon puplek en xel.
“Ekom gyeik king lam lalei me yei xel on, moxo woulek bei tambiy ti toundei inyon eno se byex teimb wei iingama yo.
Moxo teling, ‘Gweleeng, wang lam eivek xomek ne lalei nambei nya, ekom wang seng byex teimb wei iingama yo?’ Ekom tambiy on se wo lukluk.
“Woyom king neil wou e xe xel xukxe, ‘Xam tup e mema vaxa, dom nex e la myayaing nei eivek mapetok ngandoung nanghei inyon eno xel mi eng me mi nga newound mi wo nyiknyik.’
“En nambei Anutu taxe xel ngenong, ekom beyal xel nuyuw ka.”
Toungeing takis wou Sisa
Woyom xel Parisi la myayaing me yimexe sakwaing wei xel embei pakei qayeeng lek e en e maxow xe lukeing o.

Xel wong xel xe betiyeing la wou e is xel wei Herot o. Xel neil, “Putoung, xa woulek bei wang on moux wei wang mi neil zonghek o me inyon wang mi teyoxe sakwaing wei Anutu xe lalei nimza is zonghek o. Wa seng mi waleeng en xelti, en nambei wa seng mi li nenyam wou xelti xe qayeeng.
Woyom neil wou xa, wang wou naleim ambei nya? Beip inye teyeimbei xey a toung takis wou Sisa o xe se toung?”
Ekom Yesu woulek xel xe woueing nalei nilul on, om neil, “Xam wei myamim yuw o, nambei nya xam ghe di wong en xam ambei bong axeing wou ay?
Xam talex malew selewa wei xel mi toung takis eno ti me a xei.” Xel qou malew selewa ti me talex wou e,
om Yesu teling xel, “Eti xe tenu tine? Me eti lei tine?”
Xel neil elox bei, “Sisa.” Woyom moxo neil wou xel bei, “Xam ghe bong vati wei Sisa xe yo ena wou Sisa, de vati wei Anutu xe yo ena wou Anutu.”
Xel ngo tine eno xel etek mouyo. Om xel la veil e me la.
Iingama lek bouk loxyus wei qandieing lek o
Lek bouk kayon Sadyusiyeiw wei mi neil embei xel meyeing tyek se qandi lek, eno lam wou e is telinyeing ti.
Xel neil, “Putoung, Mose neil wou xa bei wangwei moux ti e mey de neu ema, ond e li moux e dii vexeiv on me bo li neuyeiw en e lei e se ma.
Woyom inyon xel lim yuw lindama toundei eivek xa senghoing. Xel lind ti tax o ii vex on me mey, de moxo se wong yak ti, om li nge wei nexlek eno ii li venei vexeiv on.
Sakwaing kayon eno li nge wei yuw me nge yal, me ela tei lek tiwei lim yuw eno teyeima.
De loxyus eno vex on mey.
Woyom lek bouk wei qandieing lek eno eivek xel lim yuw on eti venei? En inyon nambei xel xouing ii vex tiyon.”
Yesu neil elox, “Xam ghe neil esewok en inyon xam seng mi pyaw qayeeng wei di yeip eivek qapiya vambuing o me xam seng woulek Anutu xe nikanzek.
Gyeik bouk wei qandieing lek veil meyeing eno xomaxoneing tyek se diima o diima nox me noum. Tyek xel ghok ambei angelayeiw wei tyoung gheyapu nei.
Ekom qayeeng tiwei qandieing lek veil meyeing, eno beind xam seng pyaw vati wei Anutu neil wou xam bei,
‘A ne Anutu wei Apraham xe yo, Anutu wei Isaka xe yo me Anutu wei Yakop xe yo.’ Qouloum 3:6 Moxo se Anutu wei meyeing o, qe Anutu wei mapieing o.”
Xel xomaxoneing qendu tiyon ngo tine, xel etek en e xe teyoxeing.
Petieing ngandoung wei ghanaw veil o
Xel Parisi ngo bei Yesu qateiv xel Sadyusi xe lukeing, om xel Parisiyeiw toung lekti.
Eivek xel senghoing eno tambiy ti, wei wo lupeyei en petieing, eno wo axeing wou Yesu en telinyeing tine,
“Putoung, qayeeng petieing tina inye ngandoung ghanaw veil eivek petieing?”
Yesu neil elox, “‘Xam laleimim devind Tambiy Ngandoung xam xe Anutu is xam laleimim dalus me is xam numim dalus me is xam lumimpeyei dalus.’ Petieing 6:5
Tine inye qayeeng petieing tiwei tax o me ngandoung ghanaw veil.
De nge yuw wei teyei lek eno nambei nye, ‘Wa laleim devind nimpapu nge nambei wa laleim mi vind xow o.’ Lumuki 19:18
Petieing dalus me qayeeng poropet dalus eno milek qayeeng petieing yuw ne.”
Eti neu ingwei Kilisi ne
Ka xel Parisi di qekuma eno Yesu teling xel,
“Xam ghe wou naleimim ambei nya en Kilisi? Eti neu e?” Xel neil elox bei, “Dawit neu moux o.”
Moxo neil wou xel, “Woyom nambei nya Laweeng Vambuing wong kwa wou Dawit me moxo taxe e ‘Tambiy Ngandoung’? En moxo neil ambei nye,

content.text: “‘Tambiy Ngandoung neil wou a xe Tambiy Ngandoung,
a toung wa xe xel vevek eivek
wa vaxam xeinghembi le.”’ Qapiya Lalo 110:1

content: Woyom wangwei Dawit a mi taxe e bei ‘Tambiy ngandoung,’ on nambei nya ekom e yon Dawit neu moux?”
Xelti se teyei bei neil qayeeng nge nox wou e, de lek bouk kayon me ela eno xelti se mi teling e no en lulti.
